metadata.source: UNHCR Global Trends and Population Statistics Database
metadata.methodology: Displacement ratios derived from UNHCR POPSTATS database. Calculated as (peak displaced persons) / (pre-conflict population) for conflicts 2000-2023. IDP = Internally Displaced Persons. Refugee ratio = cross-border refugees / population. Conflicts with <6 months duration excluded.

SYR.note: Civil war 2011-present. ~13M displaced of ~22M pre-war population.

UKR.note: Russia-Ukraine war 2022. ~7M internal + ~8M external of ~44M population.

YEM.note: Civil war 2014-present. ~4.5M IDP, limited refugee outflow due to geography.

ETH.note: Tigray conflict 2020-2022 and other regional conflicts.

GTM.note: Gang violence, not interstate conflict — lower ratio.

VEN.note: Economic crisis-driven emigration, not war. High refugee ratio unusual for non-conflict.

PRK.note: Estimated — sealed borders limit refugee outflow historically.

IRN.note: Regional estimate; Iran hosted refugees from Afghanistan.

PAK.note: FATA/KPK internal displacement from counterinsurgency operations.

RUS.note: Chechnya conflicts. Lower ratio for large country.

CHN.note: Estimated — no major cross-border displacement in recent decades.

TWN.note: Island — heavy refugee outflow expected; IDP limited by geography.

KOR.note: Peninsula geography, significant south-to-north and civilian movement.
